title: Wednesday · Werewolf, decimals & getting connected
arrival: We will pause Werewolf for the gym, then resume. After lunch we will get connected to our classroom tools.
note: Approved plan. Teaching reference: docs/WEDNESDAY_2026-09-23.md. No LST today. Check the audiobook bookmark, Blooket and account access before class.

blocks.title: Arrival, attendance & forms
studentSteps: Settle in and answer attendance.
Hand in outstanding forms and preview our day.

blocks.title: Werewolf
studentSteps: Listen carefully and notice clues.
Make a claim, explain your evidence and disagree respectfully.

blocks.title: Pause Werewolf / Gym transition
blocks.notes: Save the exact game state privately; keep roles secret.
studentSteps: Keep roles secret. We will resume the same game afterward.
Get ready for the gym.

blocks.title: PE / Gym
blocks.notes: One-time gym block. Cooperative passing/targets with active turns for everyone; check equipment and access.
studentSteps: Practise controlled passes and target challenges together.
Choose movement, equipment and distance that help you participate.

blocks.title: Return & resume Werewolf
blocks.notes: Allow return time; pause again at snack if unfinished.
studentSteps: Continue from our saved point.
What evidence supports your claim?

blocks.title: Snack & Nevermoor
blocks.notes: Recover actual player bookmark; no Tuesday listening or journal launch.
studentSteps: Eat and listen from where we last stopped.
Tidy your space before recess.

blocks.title: Math · rounding decimals → comparing if ready
blocks.notes: Use prepared materials. At 11:30, continue rounding or begin comparing. Detailed models/checks in teaching reference.
studentSteps: Watch a model, practise and explain your rounding choices.
Move into comparing decimals when we are ready.
Choose a challenge if you finish early.

blocks.title: Lunch
blocks.notes: Usual outside-play, transition and eating routine.
studentSteps: Follow our usual outside-play and eating routine.

blocks.title: Laptops · Matific & account setup
blocks.notes: Individual access checks; record complex issues for follow-up privately. Optional unassessed test post only.
studentSteps: Begin Matific and work independently.
Wait for your individual check-in. Ask quietly for login help.
Once connected, try SpacesEDU. Keep passwords private.

blocks.title: Blooket 🎮
blocks.notes: Choose and rehearse a familiar set before class; none is verified in the Hub.
studentSteps: Join our class game.
Think, play and encourage one another.

blocks.title: Return laptops
blocks.notes: Count all issued devices back in.
studentSteps: Save and close your work.
Sign out where appropriate.
Return to the correct slot and plug in carefully.

blocks.title: Cleanup / Jobs / Planners
studentSteps: Restore our room and complete your jobs.
Record reminders and prepare for dismissal.

blocks.title: Pack up / Dismissal
studentSteps: Check your belongings.
Prepare for a calm departure.
